evidence.quoted_text:
deploy.add_argument("--health-interval-s", type=int, default=900,
                        help="delay before the second tick observation; must "
                             "exceed one runner cadence")
evidence.reason: The parser accepts any integer for --health-interval-s, including negative values, and the shown main path constructs the run without a range check. The documented constraint ("must exceed one runner cadence") is therefore unenforced, so an invalid negative delay can reach the runtime sleep logic instead of returning the usage artifact. This is an ordinary input-validation correctness defect, not a new requirement.
